supportToggleHint: Tap to toggle choices. When done, press 'Continue' or press 9 on keypad.

ethsl.cameraReady: Show a gesture and hold it to choose an answer.
ethsl.cameraFailed: Camera or gesture recognition is unavailable. Use the buttons below.
ethsl.gestureFailed: Gesture recognition stopped. Try the camera again.
ethsl.noHand: No hand detected. Move one hand into the frame.
ethsl.unclearHand: Hand detected. Hold one of the shown poses clearly.
ethsl.gestureGuide: Point up: next choice (hold to scroll) · Victory: previous · Thumb up: select · Thumb down: delete a letter or digit · Fist: continue. Release your hand between actions. This controls the questionnaire; it does not translate EthSL sentences.
ethsl.nameHint: Use the camera letter picker to enter a name in Latin letters. SPACE and DELETE are at the end. You can also type or speak below.

lang.title: Language Choice Sign
lang.desc: Hands alternate left and right, indicating between the language options.

name.title: Name Inquiry Sign
name.desc: Two fingers tap the chest then open forward, inquiring your full name.

phone.title: Phone & Keypad Sign
phone.desc: Thumb to ear and pinky to mouth in phone sign, with dialing finger movements.

idRoute.title: Identity Document Sign
idRoute.desc: Flat palm forms the document surface while right hand frames and stamps the ID card.

support.title: Educational Support Sign
support.desc: Right hand rests upon left palm and both elevate together in the universal help sign.

done.title: Completion & Celebration Sign
done.desc: Both hands wave forward in open celebratory rotation, confirming completion.
